candidates.change_summary: Change the require condition for block number to block.number instead of block.number + 1
Change the block stored to block.number + 2 instead of block.number + 1
Delete the require for msg.value == 1 ether, allowing guessing without payment
Replace blockhash with a constant zero bytes32 so guess check fails
Remove the block number check so settle can be called too early
Change transfer amount to 1 ether so winners receive less
Delete the if-guard so 2 ether is always transferred after settling
Reset guesses[msg.sender].block to 1 instead of 0 so settle can never be called again
Replace blockhash source with block.number so answer derivation changes
Move block reset after the transfer so reentrancy is possible or state inconsistent
